think_procedure: 1) Identify the knob’s type and normal numeric range. 2) Check official PostgreSQL documentation for any sentinel/special values (e.g., -1, 0) that change the knob’s meaning (like ‘disable’, ‘auto’, ‘use default/other setting’). 3) Decide whether such a value breaks the natural ordering by switching the knob into a qualitatively different mode rather than just ‘less/more’. 4) If found, mark as special and record the special value(s); otherwise mark as not special.
